reference_source_db_observation.chat: latest main uses SqlitePool and SqliteRoomRepository/SqliteMessageRepository; product retains durable Outbox/realtime and its own migrations
reference_source_db_observation.pet: SQLite product target; current reference Profile/FSM does not establish product persistence equivalence

learning_policy.daily_selection: 差異驅動＋最小功能切片；每日 TDD Red→最小 Green→Refactor→驗證，重大缺陷／阻塞／必要安全驗證在原 Day 第2節補加；不每日全量比對
learning_policy.daily_gate: latest applicable rust_ai_chat CI success; no weekly implementation gate for daily teaching
learning_policy.weekly_review: Saturday full comparison, necessary implementation, functional tests and commit; formal functional acceptance recorded separately; daily Day publication requires applicable CI success only
learning_policy.dry_run: only document corrections addressing user-reported issues; code tests migrations read-only
learning_policy.day_status: 教學已發布／程式尚待套用／功能已實作／功能正式驗收通過，依實際證據分別判定
learning_policy.content_preservation: retain original lessons; append necessary implementation at end of section 2
learning_policy.weekly_engineering: separate engineering evidence; never add weekly operations to teaching
learning_policy.phase_transition: 到期切換且不延後；功能未完成則原階段學習未完成，原項目跨階段補加，完工後回填原階段證據

curriculum.stage_topics: FUTURE_WORK.md 既有開發項目對應 P0–P12 的功能完成條件及證據；每日 Day 題目不預排

stage_boundary_notifications.trigger: 按進度證據提前或日曆到期切換，通知一次；階段結束不等於學習完成，功能完成後回填原階段

curriculum.stage_completion_policy: 到期階段結束且下一階段正常開始；功能未完成不得標記學習完成。原開發項目及原 Day 實作內容後補加跨階段工作，功能完成後回填原階段日期／證據；正式驗收獨立。
